title: Ingest v5-grounded benchmark: NO-WIN — productization not yet justified
summary: The self-improvement loop evaluated whether ingestion (grounded, retrievable KB via search_knowledge) earns a place in the product. Verdict on the v5-grounded benchmark (5 trials/arm, ON=--consult=search vs OFF=general knowledge, opus): NO-WIN. METRIC=(H_off-H_on)*5-C = -21,582 tok-eq (negative). Hardness went UP not down (H_on=2674 > H_off=2023); real work identical (W 230 vs 232); both arms solved 100% (model didn't need the note); consult overhead C=+18,329 tok-eq. Conclusion: ingest is a measured NET LOSS on this task — it does NOT fit the product on current evidence. Consistent with the standing 'no benefit measured yet' pattern across v2/v3/v4. Ingest remains a one-off spike (scripts hardcode this repo, no setup wiring), NOT the drop-in feature, and the benchmark says don't productize it yet.
